mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.name AS skuName, p.name AS productName, s.images AS image, COALESCE(i.total_stock, s.stock) AS totalStock, COALESCE(i.locked_stock, 0) AS lockedStock, COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) AS availableStock, COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10) AS safetyStock, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) <= COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS warning, COALESCE(i.update_time, s.update_time) AS updateTime FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id
ORDER BY COALESCE(i.update_time, s.update_time) DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id
